method: Five whole file reads with Git blob verification, static analysis only.
findings: api.h exposes command-line header and GLib types, not a separate minimal exact-file comparison API.

GUI uses execvp shredder with forwarded argv, no shell interpolation. Forwarding loop bounds i by sizeof(all_argv)/2 bytes rather than pointer count;512-slot array can be exceeded with sufficiently many arguments on32/64-bit. Not runtime reproduced.
Logger color removal assumes every escape has a later m; strchr NULL then loop increment is not handled. Actual filename/log-message reachability not checked.
rm_log_error maps to G_LOG_LEVEL_CRITICAL, not G_LOG_LEVEL_ERROR; logged error alone need not terminate process or set result status. Earlier g_error long-path call remains separately fatal.

Log line macros use function-local static mutex in static-inline header helper, giving per-translation-unit mutexes rather than one explicit global log-line lock. Concurrent output interleaving possible; not tested.
Logger verbosity/prettiness settings are process-global without synchronization in these files; initialization discipline remains caller responsibility.
limits: No GUI launch, crash reproduction or logging stress run; no own-library edits/tests.
Native pHash deferred; global full repository count150/500.
